about: Money, help and people on campus that a CS student can use.

entries.name: Wesleyan Summer Grants
entries.about: Funding for summer experiences, including unpaid or underpaid internships and research.

entries.name: Career Development Grant
entries.about: Helps cover career-related costs at any point in your four years at Wesleyan.

entries.name: Career advising
entries.about: Advisors by field, including one for science and mathematics, plus internship search help.

entries.name: New Venture Awards
entries.about: Awards for student projects, organizations and companies, with a nonprofit and a for-profit track. The center also gives smaller grants for prototypes.

entries.name: Tutoring
entries.about: Drop-in tutors for programming, SQL, MATLAB and statistical software, starting the second week of each semester.

entries.name: Summer Apprenticeship
entries.about: Funded summer research with faculty, using statistics, high-performance computing, GIS or text analysis. Faculty nominate students each spring.
